sources.entry: Bulchimbeon - Menu bar app that keeps the Mac awake only while AI coding agents are working, with lid-closed mode and heat and battery safeguards.

summary.one_liner: Bulchimbeon is a macOS menu bar app (with a Linux daemon and tray icon) that keeps the Mac awake only while AI coding agents such as Claude Code or Codex are actively working, then lets it sleep.
summary.what_it_does: It detects running AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor Agent, Copilot CLI, Aider, OpenCode, plus user-defined ones) by scanning the user's own processes, and counts an agent as working only when it has a caffeinate child process or its process tree uses at least 2% CPU averaged over 60 seconds. It holds a sleep lock while on duty and hands over after 5 minutes (adjustable) of quiet. Watch modes include keeping the display on, letting the display sleep, or staying awake with the lid closed (which needs admin approval and runs pmset disablesleep). It also offers timed watches, a battery stand-down threshold, heat advisories with automatic cooling pauses, a watchdog that restores lid sleep, and a once-a-day update check that only installs after the user confirms. The README also describes a Linux version with a systemd user daemon, CLI status and doctor commands, and a StatusNotifier tray icon.
use_cases: keep Mac awake while AI agent runs overnight
prevent sleep during long coding agent tasks
stop caffeinate from being left on by accident
keep closed laptop running agent with lid closed
stay awake during builds and tests triggered by an agent
Linux daemon to inhibit suspend while coding agents work
how_to_run: Or download the latest macOS zip from Releases and move it to /Applications
open -a Bulchimbeon (first launch needs System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway)
Linux: brew install s3onghyun/tap/bulchimbeon-linux && brew services start bulchimbeon-linux
notable: Watches from outside: detects agents by process metadata and CPU use, so no hooks or agent config changes are needed
Lid-closed mode with a watchdog that restores normal sleep within 5 seconds after the watch ends or the app quits
Heat advisory and combat rest that pause the watch when the Mac overheats and resume once it cools
Pixel-art private menu bar mascot with a patrol mode and multilingual UI (Korean, English, Simplified Chinese)
Linux port that shares the same duty engine and golden test cases
caveats: Requires macOS 13 or later; the app is ad-hoc signed and not yet notarized, so macOS blocks the first launch
Lid-closed mode requires an admin password each time it is turned on; Linux lid closing still suspends by default
Agents running in Docker or over SSH on another host are not detected
